description.text: Objectives The program in Chinese Language and Literature provides students with basic theory and knowledge of Chinese language and to equip them with good skills in Chinese listening, speaking, reading, and writing. The program covers subjects of Chinese traditional culture, arts, philosophy, contemporary Chinese politics, and economic and legal systems in China. Students from the program will have a good employment opportunity in government agencies, corporations, media and cultural institutions or in related fields that are involved with China. Students can easily apply for further degree program in China if they plan so.Duration Duration of the program is 4 years with course works in the first three years, followed by a thesis project and practice.Degree Awarded A Bachelor of Art is awarded for students who meet the requirement for graduation.Main Courses (Elementary, Intermediate, Advanced) Comprehensive Chinese, Oral Chinese, Listening Chinese, (Intermediate, Advanced) Writing, (Elementary, Intermediate) Reading

duration.text: The Chinese Language and Literature at Harbin Institute of Technology(Shenzhen Campus) is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4166 USD/per year ￥ 30000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1) A copy of passport (the original passport will be checked during registration) 2) One passport-size photo (35mm*50mm) 3) Graduation certificate of high schoolGraduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.4) Academic transcript of high school

requirements.text: 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport. 2. Be Healthy. 3. Under the age of 30 4. Have attained a senior high school diploma with good marks. 5. Have solid financial support to afford the study and living expense in China. 6. Good English reading, writing and speaking skills.
